method: A recording-level review of the strongest top-level family contradictions exposed by the Every Noise reference audit. Each correction is track-scoped, requires an explicit current artist-membership genre that maps unambiguously to the requested taxonomy and agrees with the recording identity, and remains medium confidence because the membership bridge is not a recording-level genre database. Crossovers, ambiguous families, and World assignments are excluded.
